text: Put a controlled change in sequence
After this you can organize a typical change request from idea to verified completion.
No controlled installation is complete merely because a proposal exists.

items: Write the proposed difference: Inferred: The request needs a defined scope.
Collect impacts and affected versions: A decision needs relevant consequences.
Obtain the authorized decision: The responsible role accepts, declines or defers.
Release any accepted work: Implementers need controlled instructions.
Check and record completion: Evidence establishes which items changed.

text: A decision and actual work must both be recorded.
